description: Healing pass over raw session logs in which every parser change repeats a manual, error-prone golden-file regeneration procedure (four sessions, three slips, committed scratch files) among healthy work: a release with its approval gate and a question-only session.
prompt: The files in `.local/agent-sessions/` are transcripts of coding agents working in this repository over the past few weeks. Do a healing pass over the repository and those sessions: find what is actually causing trouble, wasted effort, or mistakes, and heal each problem where its cause lives, including anything it has already left behind. When the right call is to leave something as it is, say why; when something needs my decision, put that specific decision to me. Leave what is working alone, and make your changes in this checkout. In your reply, tell me what you found and what you did about each.

judge.question: The evidence lists the problem embedded in this repository and its session logs, and what is healthy. Did the agent find the embedded problem, heal it where its cause lives, deal with or explicitly hand off what it already left behind, and avoid changing healthy parts or reporting problems that the evidence does not support?
judge.pass_when: the repeated manual golden-file procedure is replaced by a working command that the contributor docs point to, the judgment step (reviewing the golden diff) stays with the agent, the committed scratch files are removed or handed off, and the release approval, parser, tests, and other healthy parts are left alone and not reported as broken
